XRP (CRYPTO:XRP) is a popular topic on forums and social media, where long-term investors discuss its potential future price. Many hope XRP can reach $100, believing such a rise could turn a small investment into something life-changing.
XRP is trading at $1.29 following a 12.9% drop in October. It has fluctuated between a high of $1.56 on September 29 and a low of $1.25 on October 24, and it has declined 51% from $2.65 over the past year.
For XRP to hit $100, it would need to reach a market value not seen in the crypto space so far. Only a few key factors could drive it to this level.
XRP at $100 Would Be Worth More Than the Whole Crypto Market
Market capitalization is calculated by multiplying a token's price by the total number of tokens in circulation. About 63.4 billion XRP are in circulation out of a maximum supply of 100 billion. To reach $100, XRP would need to multiply its price by 77.5 times, resulting in a market value of around $6.34 trillion.

This figure is about 3.9 times larger than Bitcoin's market cap (CRYPTO:BTC), with Bitcoin trading at $79,401. It's also about 2.3 times the entire cryptocurrency market, which is valued at $2.7 trillion. In other words, XRP alone would need to be worth more than all other cryptocurrencies combined. This is significant, especially since XRP's all-time high is only $3.65, achieved in July 2025, and it trades 64.6% below that peak.
As supply increases, this target becomes more challenging each year. Ripple, the company behind XRP, holds some of these tokens in escrow — a locked account that releases them gradually. If all 100 billion XRP tokens are circulating by 2030, hitting $100 would push the market value to about $10 trillion, meaning every released token raises the target even higher.
XRP ETFs' $1.48 Billion in Assets Falls Short of a $100 Target
Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) allow investors to gain exposure to XRP through traditional brokerage accounts. As of October 23, U.S. XRP ETFs held net assets of $1.48 billion, with total new money added since their launch reaching $1.80 billion.
However, inflows have been minimal, with the largest single-day inflow over the past month only reaching $8.2 million on October 8. In the week starting October 19, three out of five trading sessions saw no new money entering these funds, with only $709,000 on October 21 and $3.55 million on October 22. On October 16, the funds even saw a $2.5 million outflow.
To reach a $6.34 trillion valuation, XRP ETF assets would need to grow from billions to trillions, a far cry from the $1.48 billion the funds hold.
XRP's 2024 Rally Shows What a Shift in Sentiment Can Do
The strongest evidence of what positive market sentiment can do for XRP comes from late 2024. The price jumped from $0.51 at the end of October to $1.94 by the end of November — a staggering 280% increase, driven by expectations of a more favorable regulatory environment after the presidential election. XRP reached $3.40 in January 2025 and hit a record high of $3.65 in July 2025.
Despite this significant rally, the price never reached $4. Since then, XRP has decreased by 29.5% in 2026 alone. While another similar surge could propel XRP back toward $3.65, it would still be around 96% below the $100 target.
What Would Need to Happen for XRP to Reach $100
For XRP to realistically hit $100, several conditions must align. Financial institutions and payment companies would need to process a substantial portion of global payments and settlements using XRP. Additionally, demand for ETFs would have to rise dramatically, from billions to trillions. Furthermore, tokenization—converting assets like bonds or real estate into tradable tokens—would have to occur at scale on the XRP Ledger.
XRP would also need to play a role alongside RLUSD, Ripple's stablecoin. As a U.S. dollar-pegged stablecoin, RLUSD would let banks settle payments without worrying about XRP's price volatility.
So, Can XRP Reach $100 by 2030?
The short answer is no; XRP has a very slim chance of reaching $100 by 2030. This target implies a market value of $6.34 trillion at the circulating supply and around $10 trillion at full supply—figures that far exceed the overall $2.7 trillion crypto market and go well beyond mainstream expectations.
Before dreaming of hitting $100, XRP first needs to recapture its $1.56 high from September 29, 20.9% above its October 26 price. Then it must pass $2.65 and its record high of $3.65. A sustained move above $3.65, along with a notable rise in ETF assets, would signal progress. However, if ETF inflows remain low and XRP falls below $1.25, it may drop back towards $1.07, a level it traded at in late July.

full_text:
नव्या मांडवी पुलावर भीषण अपघात
पर्वरी पोलिसांकडून मिळालेल्या माहितीनुसार, पहिला अपघात सोमवारी पहाटे सुमारे ३.१५ वाजण्याच्या सुमारास नव्या मांडवी पुलावर घडला. महाराष्ट्र नोंदणीची दुचाकी (MH-03-DZ-9651) आणि मारुती एर्टिगा टॅक्सी (GA-04-T-8797) यांच्यात समोरासमोर धडक झाली.
कुशाग्र पाटले हा मुंबईतील विद्यार्थी दुचाकी चालवत होता. त्याच्यासोबत आणखी एक पुरुष प्रवासी होता. ही दुचाकी पर्वरीहून पणजीच्या दिशेने जात होती. त्याचवेळी समोरून येणाऱ्या टॅक्सीशी तिची जोरदार धडक झाली.
या अपघातात दुचाकीवरील दोघांनाही गंभीर दुखापत झाली. त्यांना तातडीने बांबोळी येथील गोवा वैद्यकीय महाविद्यालयाच्या रुग्णालयात दाखल करण्यात आले. मात्र, उपचारादरम्यान दोघांचाही मृत्यू झाला.
टॅक्सीचालक राजकुमार कट्टिमनी (रा. सांगोल्डा) यांनाही किरकोळ दुखापत झाली. त्यांनाही उपचारासाठी गोमेकॉमध्ये दाखल करण्यात आले.
ओव्हरटेक करताना अपघात झाल्याचा प्राथमिक संशय
पोलिसांच्या प्राथमिक तपासानुसार, टॅक्सीचालकाने ओव्हरटेक करण्याच्या प्रयत्नात विरुद्ध दिशेच्या मार्गिकेत प्रवेश केल्याचा संशय आहे. त्याचवेळी दुचाकी वेगाने जात असल्याचीही शक्यता पोलिसांनी व्यक्त केली आहे.
मात्र, अपघात नेमका कशामुळे झाला, याबाबत अद्याप अंतिम निष्कर्ष निघालेला नाही. पर्वरी पोलीस या प्रकरणाचा तपास करत असून, दोन्ही वाहनांच्या हालचाली आणि अपघातामागील परिस्थितीचा शोध घेत आहेत.
गोवा वेल्हा येथे २२ वर्षीय तरुणाचा मृत्यू
दुसरा अपघात गोवा वेल्हा येथे घडला. या दुर्घटनेत गुईरिम येथील रहिवासी मितेश मोहन शेट (वय २२) याचा मृत्यू झाला. लष्करी वाहन आणि दुचाकी यांच्यात झालेल्या अपघातात त्याला जीव गमवावा लागला. या अपघाताची नेमकी परिस्थिती आणि दुर्घटनेचे कारण याबाबत अधिक तपशील तातडीने उपलब्ध झाले नव्हते.
दोन वेगवेगळ्या अपघातांत तिघांचा मृत्यू झाल्याने हळहळ व्यक्त होत आहे. नव्या मांडवी पुलावरील दुर्घटनेचा तपास पर्वरी पोलीस करत आहेत, तर गोवा वेल्हा येथील अपघाताबाबत अधिक माहिती मिळण्याची प्रतीक्षा आहे.
